tip.intro: What a week. You added 37 contracts and pushed us to 657/700 (94%). You also cut the people holding beds without completed approval from 47 to 22, more than half gone in one week. Carriage House is 100% full. That's great work, and it shows.
tip.closing: We're close, so let's finish strong. Every team has the same focus this week: 43 beds are still open, 22 people are holding a bed without completed approval, and 42 leads are inactive. Haven Blue has the most to go, with 22 open beds, 8 unsigned and 14 inactive leads. Henry Ford said, "Whether you think you can or you think you can't, you're right." I think we can. Work those lists, get every contract signed and get the payment in.
